source.selection: Active severity reviews for cases in the current taxonomy. Exclude undone submissions and retain unknown rubric versions without inferring a version.

rubric.question_uk: Уявіть, що в це повірило багато людей. Наскільки серйозні наслідки це матиме для тих, про кого це сказано?
rubric.instruction_uk: Оцінюйте сам стереотип, а не формулювання.
rubric.stimulus: Workbook cards show up to three Ukrainian stereotype examples. Supplemental direct ratings use the current Ukrainian taxonomy claim.

interpretation.score: An equal-weight mean of independent ratings with the selected confirmed rubric version. Individual ratings and their gap remain available with the aggregate.
interpretation.pending: Fewer than two compatible ratings leave severity_score and its bracket null. The calculation audit lists ratings with unknown rubric versions as excluded.
interpretation.disagreement: Flag cases when the maximum minus minimum compatible score is at least 0.4. Preserve the case mean and the individual ratings.
interpretation.inheritance: Triplets inherit their case mean, bracket and status through case_id. Source examples and current text have separate hash bindings. Both languages carry the same case-level severity annotation.
interpretation.brackets: Map the assigned mean on the 0–100 scale to five equal-width brackets. Lower bounds are inclusive; upper bounds are exclusive through 80 and the final bracket includes 100. Pending means retain a null bracket.

additional_sources.claim_uk: Чоловіки з групи [TARGET] повинні першими йти служити, а не переїжджати в безпечніші місця.
